posts.title: Meet Squlpt
posts.caption:
We're David and Philipe, and we're building Squlpt.

It's a tool for interior designers. You upload a photo of a room, click on a wall, the floor or the sofa, and try other materials, colours and furniture right in the picture.

You make all the choices. Squlpt shows what they look like, so it's quicker to show a client what you have in mind.

We're in a closed beta and looking for interior designers who want to try it for free. Send us a DM if you're curious.

posts.title: How it works
posts.caption:
A quick look at how Squlpt works:

1. Upload a photo of the room
2. Click on what you want to change
3. Generate and compare versions
4. Share them with your client as a link, a PDF or an FF&E schedule

#interiordesignprocess #interiordesigner #designprocess #interiordesign
alt: Headline: "How Squlpt works. Four steps."
Step 1: upload a photo of the room, shown with a kitchen photo.
Step 2: click on what you want to change, with a marker on the kitchen cabinets labelled "Cabinets: brushed steel".
Step 3: generate and compare, shown with the updated kitchen.
Step 4: show your client with a review link, a PDF with your logo or an FF&E schedule.

posts.title: You do the designing
posts.caption:
Squlpt doesn't design rooms on its own, and that's on purpose.

You choose the materials, colours and pieces. Squlpt shows what they look like in the room, so you can try more ideas and show your client something concrete sooner.

#interiordesigner #interiordesign #interiorarchitect #designbusiness

"You pick every material, colour and piece."
"Try a few versions in one afternoon."
"Made for working with clients": review links, PDF exports with your logo, FF&E schedules and schemes side by side.
